about: Literature many-body potentials for crystal and filler groups of composites (Field · by group). Each file is LAMMPS's own, copied unchanged from the potentials folder of the LAMMPS distribution with its header (date, units, contributor, citation); CAPS writes it beside the LAMMPS inputs of a system that uses it. Cite the paper given with each.

potentials.name: B–N–C Tersoff (Kinaci 2012)
potentials.for: graphene, carbon nanotubes, h-BN and BN–C hybrid sheets
potentials.citation: Kinaci, Haskins, Sevik and Cagin,  Phys Rev B, 86, 115410 (2012)

potentials.name: Si–C Tersoff (Tersoff 1989)
potentials.for: silicon carbide, silicon, diamond and other sp3 carbon

potentials.name: Si–C Tersoff (Erhart & Albe 2005)
potentials.citation: Erhart and Albe, Phys Rev B, 71, 035211 (2005)

potentials.name: Si modified Tersoff (Kumagai 2007)
potentials.citation: Kumagai, Izumi, Hara and Sakai, Comp Mat Sci, 39, 457 (2007)

potentials.name: Si–O Tersoff (Munetoh 2007)
potentials.for: silica fillers: quartz and amorphous SiO₂ (precipitated / fumed silica cores)
potentials.citation: S. Mumetoh et al, Comp Mat Sci, 39, 334-339 (2007)

potentials.name: Si–O Vashishta (Vashishta 1990)

potentials.name: Si–C Vashishta (Vashishta 2007)
